business_summary: Lingda Group Co., Ltd. provides general contracting services for photovoltaic power plant in China. The company operates through Waste heat power generation business, Photovoltaic power generation business, Solar cell business, and EPC engineering business segments. It is involved in energy saving services, solar photovoltaic power generation, solar cells business, as well as undertakes photovoltaic power station project. Lingda Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 2005 and is based in Luan, China.
